       FILTERING
       ======================================== */

      const cards = Array.from(postGrid.querySelectorAll('.post-card'));

      cards.forEach(card => {
        const cat = card.dataset.category;
        const title = card.dataset.title;
        const excerpt = card.dataset.excerpt;
        const matchesCategory = currentCategory === 'all' || cat === currentCategory;
        const matchesSearch = !currentSearch || title.includes(currentSearch) || excerpt.includes(currentSearch);

        if (matchesCategory && matchesSearch) {
          card.classList.remove('hidden');
          visibleCount++;
        } else {
          card.classList.add('hidden');
        }
      });

      if (visibleCount === 0) {
        noResults.classList.remove('hidden');
      } else {
        noResults.classList.add('hidden');
      }

        currentCategory = e.target.dataset.category;
        filterPosts();
      }
    });

    // Search
    searchInput.addEventListener('input', (e) => {
      currentSearch = e.target.value.trim().toLowerCase();
      filterPosts();
    });

      if (extraLoaded) return;
      const fragment = document.createDocumentFragment();
      extraPosts.forEach(post => {
        const wrapper = document.createElement('div');
        wrapper.innerHTML = renderPostCard(post);
        fragment.appendChild(wrapper.firstElementChild);
      });
      postGrid.appendChild(fragment);
      extraLoaded = true;
      loadMoreWrap.style.display = 'none';
      filterPosts();
    });

    // Dropdowns
    document.querySelectorAll('.nav-item[data-dropdown]').forEach(item => {
      const trigger = item.querySelector('.nav-trigger');

      function open() {
        document.querySelectorAll('.nav-item.open').forEach(i => {
          if (i !== item) {
            i.classList.remove('open');
            i.querySelector('.nav-trigger').setAttribute('aria-expanded', 'false');
          }
        });
        item.classList.add('open');
        trigger.setAttribute('aria-expanded', 'true');
      }

      function close() {
        item.classList.remove('open');
        trigger.setAttribute('aria-expanded', 'false');
      }

      trigger.addEventListener('click', (e) => {
        e.stopPropagation();
        if (item.classList.contains('open')) {
          close();
        } else {
          open();
        }
      });

      item.addEventListener('mouseenter', open);
      item.addEventListener('mouseleave', close);
    });

    document.addEventListener('click', () => {
      document.querySelectorAll('.nav-item.open').forEach(i => {
        i.classList.remove('open');
        i.querySelector('.nav-trigger').setAttribute('aria-expanded', 'false');
      });
    });

    /* ========================================
       INIT
       ======================================== */
    renderFeatured();
    renderPosts(allPosts);

The DeployCloud Blog landing page has been built and output to `/app/output/`. Here's a summary of what was created:

### Files Generated
| File | Description |
|------|-------------|
| `index.html` | Main blog landing page (single-file, no build step) |
| `robots.txt` | Crawler directives with sitemap reference |
| `sitemap.xml` | SEO sitemap per the skill workflow |

### Page Sections Implemented
1. **Sticky Header** — Logo, main nav with Products & Resources mega-menus (click + hover), auth actions
2. **Category Filters** — 9 pill buttons (All Posts → Press) with active state styling
3. **Search** — Real-time filtering with "No results found at this time..." message
4. **Featured Articles** — 3 prominent cards with stats row on the first (30%, 1000%, 20×)
5. **Latest News Grid** — 3-column responsive grid (collapses to 2, then 1) with category tags, dates, excerpts, author avatars
6. **Load More** — "Show more posts" button appends 6 additional pre-loaded cards
7. **CTA Banner** — Dark section with primary/secondary CTAs + Enterprise block
8. **Footer** — 10-column link grid + status badge

### Interactions
- **Category filtering** — pills highlight and grid updates instantly
- **Search** — combined with category filter, shows no-results state
- **Dropdowns** — Products (AI Cloud / Core Platform / Security) and Resources (Company / Learn / Open Source) mega-menus
- **Responsive** — breakpoints at 1024px, 768px, and 480px for graceful collapse

- Complete `<head>` meta tags, Open Graph, Twitter Cards
- Canonical URL, viewport, favicon links
- JSON-LD structured data: `Organization` + `Blog` schemas
